input: Look into surrogacy agencies and initial consultations

gold.taskTitle: Research Surrogacy Agencies and Book Consultations
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to explore surrogacy agencies and schedule initial consultations as a step toward pursuing surrogacy.

questions.title: Are you pursuing surrogacy as an intended parent or surrogate?
questions.description: Understanding the user's role will determine which type of agencies and consultations are relevant.

questions.title: What country or region should the agencies be based in?
questions.description: Location narrows the agency search to legally and logistically relevant options.

questions.title: Have you already spoken to a doctor or fertility specialist?
questions.description: Knowing prior medical involvement helps determine how early in the process the user is.

questions.title: Do you have a budget range in mind for the surrogacy process?
questions.description: Budget constraints will filter agencies by cost tier and service scope.

questions.title: Are you open to domestic surrogacy, international, or both?
questions.description: This determines whether international agency options should be included in research.

questions.title: Do you have a timeline or target start date in mind?
questions.description: A deadline shapes how urgently consultations need to be scheduled and researched.

questions.title: What specific concerns matter most to you in an agency?
questions.description: For example: legal support, success rates, communication style, or LGBTQ+ experience.
